info.description: The stable /v1 API of docker-agent-desktop: shell, files, browser, display, apps, sessions, health and the activity log, plus the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint. There is no unversioned /api surface: it was removed in the initial release, together with the pre-rename auth names, rather than deprecated.
info.title: Docker Agent Desktop API

get.description: Bare 200. Container liveness only, not session health: use GET /v1/health for whether the session is actually usable.

post.description: The Model Context Protocol surface, served as Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0, stateless). Every tool calls the same Agent service methods the /v1 HTTP handlers call — never an HTTP round-trip to self. Mutating tools enforce the session rule in-process (live session required, id must match, session must not be paused); reads never require a session. See docs/mcp.md for the tool list.

400.description: Not a JSON-RPC request, or a non-POST method

get.description: Lists the registry apps with whether each is running. The browser (port 0) is running when its screencast is attached.

post.description: Starts one registry app: its Broadway display first, then the app. Starting an app that is already running does nothing. The browser (port 0) has no process to start; this reports whether Chromium is running instead.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

post.description: Stops one registry app and reports it as not running. Unknown ids are a 400, mirroring start. The browser (port 0) has no app process, so stopping it stops Chromium. The app's broadwayd display stays running for reuse.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

get.description: One frame of the page. Without ?since it takes a fresh screenshot (JPEG by default, PNG with ?format=png). With ?since=N it serves the screencast for a polling client: 204 when no frame newer than N exists. The X-Frame-Seq header carries the frame sequence number to poll with next.

get.description: The live browser socket: binary JPEG frames and navigation-state messages pumped down, navigate/pointer/key/scroll/paste/size commands read in order. A WebSocket cannot carry the X-Dad-Session header, so the session travels as ?session=<id> at connect, or a {"type":"session","session_id":"..."} message that (re)binds the socket mid-connection. Frames and state flow without a session (reads); every control message is refused while no live, unpaused session is bound. A ?session= naming no live session is a 409 at connect time. Control messages carrying an "id" get an {"type":"ack","id","ok","error"} reply.

parameters.description: Session id to bind at connect (control messages need a live, unpaused session bound)
parameters.name: session

409.description: ?session= names no live session

delete.description: Removes a file or directory. Directories need recursive=true unless empty. The home directory itself can never be deleted. A final symlink is removed itself, never its target.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

400.description: Path missing, escapes the jail, is home itself, or a non-empty directory without recursive

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

get.description: Lists one jailed directory. ?path= is home-relative (empty means home). Paths are home-relative in the reply.

post.description: Creates a directory and its parents, jailed under home.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

400.description: Path missing or escapes the jail

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

post.description: Renames within the jail. The destination must not already exist. Deleting or moving the home directory itself is refused.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

400.description: from/to missing, path escapes the jail, destination exists, or home itself

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

get.description: Returns one file's bytes, capped at 10 MiB. ?download=1 adds a Content-Disposition attachment header.

400.description: Path escapes the home jail, or is a directory

post.description: Writes one multipart file (field "file") to the "path" form field. A trailing slash (or an existing directory) means "into this directory". The whole body is bounded, so an oversized upload cannot fill the disk with multipart temp files.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

400.description: Missing file/path fields, or path escapes the jail

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

post.description: Writes data, creating parent directories as needed. Content over 10 MiB is refused, so everything written can be read back. Encoding "text" (default) writes the content as-is; "base64" decodes it first.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

400.description: Path missing, path escapes the jail, or bad encoding/base64

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

get.description: The real health check: whether the session is actually usable. Probes Chromium, Broadway, disk space and the session lease, and reports each piece, so a caller can tell a dead browser from a dead display from a full disk instead of getting one opaque 503. A transition into degraded is recorded once in the activity log.
The live session (or null) plus browser state, viewer count, running apps and uptime: what a waiting caller needs to decide whether to wait.

post.description: Acquires the single session lease. Exactly one holder at a time: a second acquire is a 409 naming the current holder. The lease TTL defaults to 90 s (DAD_SESSION_LEASE_MS, clamped to 10 s..10 min); keep it alive with POST /v1/session/keepalive.

400.description: holder.name missing or holder.kind not agent/user

409.description: Session already held

get.description: Activity-log events with sequence number greater than ?since=, up to ?limit= (default 100, max 500). Poll with the latest_seq returned to follow the log.

parameters.description: Only events with seq greater than this
parameters.name: since

200.description: Events and the latest sequence number

post.description: Extends the lease on a live session. A keepalive for an expired, released or taken-over session is a 409: re-acquire instead.

409.description: No such session, or held by someone else

post.description: Pauses or resumes the live session. While paused, control messages are refused but the lease is still held. A pause/resume for a session that is not the live one is a 409.

409.description: No such session, or held by someone else

post.description: Releases a live session. Releasing a session that is not held is a 404.
Pauses or resumes the live session. While paused, control messages are refused but the lease is still held. A pause/resume for a session that is not the live one is a 409.

409.description: No such session, or held by someone else

post.description: Force-acquires the lease, evicting whoever holds it. Requires explicit "force": true — evicting another holder is deliberate, never accidental. The evicted holder is named in the activity log and in the response, so a takeover is always visible after the fact.

201.description: New session and the evicted one (or null)

400.description: force is not true, or holder.name missing / holder.kind not agent/user

post.description: Long-polls until the lease is free or the timeout elapses (default 30 s, clamped to 1 s..5 min). It never acquires: it only reports. A caller that sees free=true still has to acquire — another contender can take the lease between the wait returning and the acquire landing. A read, so no session is needed to call it.
post.summary: Wait for the session to free up

post.description: Runs one command. Exactly one of command (/bin/sh -c) or argv (direct exec) must be set. Synchronously unless background=true, in which case it starts the process and returns immediately with status "running" and a job id to poll. Non-zero exits are results with status "failed", not errors. Output is capped at 1 MiB per stream.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

400.description: Neither or both of command/argv set

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

get.description: All tracked jobs, oldest first. A running job reports the output captured so far and its elapsed time.
One job's current result. A running job reports the output captured so far and its elapsed time.

post.description: SIGKILLs a running job's whole process group (children included). Waits briefly for the waiter to finalize the result, so the response reflects the kill.

parameters.description: Session id of the live session
parameters.name: X-Dad-Session

409.description: No live session, or held by someone else

seq.description: Seq increases whenever any other field changes, so callers can detect updates cheaply.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Agent token, set from DAD_TOKEN. The dad_token portal cookie is accepted as an alternative.
